proposedTestOnlyRule.type: Branch-local mechanic for one synthetic W2 fixture; not canonical.

definitions.restrainedSystemMassLb: Restrained body + attached/worn gear and cargo + Conjure Rope, each counted once.
definitions.upwardRestraintLoadLb: Equal to restrainedSystemMassLb. This is a new 1:1 test convention in pound-equivalent units, not a source-defined physical-force conversion.
definitions.effectiveCapacityLb: Lower of the bound Conjure Rope operational playtest limit of 300 lb and the newly defined 250-lb TEST_ONLY complete assembly rating. These values are limited to this reviewed branch; this proposal makes no canon-promotion claim.
definitions.tautBehavior: Inextensible for this test. Slack is consumed geometrically; at first taut contact, vertical velocity is set to zero before immediate quasi-static sampling, so no impact or dynamic multiplier is introduced.
definitions.threshold: At each taut sample and every subsequent applicable mass change, test both limits independently. Each component fails only if its current load exceeds its rating; equality holds. If both limits are exceeded, both failure results apply.
definitions.eventEnd: This W2 branch treats upward displacement as a bounded TEST_ONLY event from t=18 through t=24, at 10 ft/s. The event itself is the only upward support in this fixture and terminates at t=24; it supplies no later suspension. If the tether releases during the event, only the still-scheduled displacement before t=24 applies. At t=24, ordinary Falling begins if the target is unsupported.
definitions.loadRecheck: Never grandfather the first-taut sample. Recalculate the full current body + attached/worn gear/cargo + rope load whenever an applicable mass change occurs while connected; apply rope overload and assembly release immediately.
definitions.failureAssembly: For the branch-only 250-lb assembly, the support-side synthetic weak link releases above 250 lb without damaging/moving the fixed support. The rope itself remains unless its separate 300-lb limit is exceeded.

sequence: Use only the supplied synthetic 60-ft upward movement schedule, beginning at t=18 and ending at t=24; do not assert an actual spell cast, actor, campaign event, or additional Reverse Gravity source rule.
The event requests 10 ft/s upward movement. Consume only the measured tether slack as the target rises; no Rope command lifts, hauls, or draws slack for free.

At first taut contact (t=22 in the base fixture), stop vertical velocity before the immediate quasi-static sample. A load within both ratings holds the target at that point and blocks only the remaining movement scheduled before t=24.

If the assembly load exceeds 250 lb, release its support-side synthetic weak link immediately. If the rope load exceeds 300 lb, the whole rope immediately vanishes under its bound overload rule. Evaluate these results independently; simultaneous exceedance causes both.
Recheck both current limits immediately after every applicable mass change, including changes after the first-taut sample.
If a restraint ends before t=24, apply only the remaining 10-ft/s scheduled displacement until t=24; never replay prior movement.

At t=24 the synthetic upward event ends. The tether anchored below does not keep the target aloft; ordinary Falling starts, with its rescue window, Fall Marker, landing, damage, and condition handled by the bound provisional falling procedure for this TEST_ONLY review.
Keep body, gear, cargo, rope, support, assembly, and custody records; preserve Conjure Rope's original t=600-second expiry.

attachmentSetup.operation: After the coil appears, TEST_HANDLER_A manually secures one end to the support assembly. This is a synthetic manual operation, not a Rope command.

TEST_HANDLER_B manually routes and secures the other end to the consenting target's side D-ring. The 40-ft slack bight is staged in the supported, unobstructed tray beside the channel. This is a synthetic manual operation, not a Rope command.

Both handlers clear the ascent/fall corridor; no Rope commands are used. The creation point, support surface, platform, target access, route, end connections, permissions, and slack are fixed and inspected before the movement event.

support.kind: Synthetic fixed structural support at the lower service-channel wall
support.ratingScope: TEST_ONLY complete load-bearing assembly rating, including the anchor/support, both end connections, terminal connectors, waist harness, and harness D-ring; no individual included element may be below this 250-lb assembly limit.
support.overrating: Above 250 lb, the synthetic support-side weak link releases; the fixed support is not damaged or moved.

tether.path: Vertical from support end at [0,0,-8.5] to the target's side D-ring at [0,0,1.5], alongside (not through) the target's body envelope.
tether.slackStorage: One measured 40-ft bight in the supported tray beside the channel; it is part of the 50-ft rope and is manually staged before movement.
tether.slackTakeup: 1 ft of vertical target travel consumes 1 ft of this slack; no commanded lifting, hauling, or slack-drawing occurs.
tether.endpointAccess: Both endpoints are within the named handlers' reach and the support/platform surfaces; both manual connections are made before movement.
tether.endpointCapacities: Both rope-end connections and the waist harness/D-ring are included in the same 250-lb TEST_ONLY complete assembly rating.

movement.classification: Synthetic TEST_ONLY movement input, not an actual spell cast/campaign event.
movement.upwardSupportActive: Only during the scripted event, t=18..24.

load.result: Within both capacities; the complete assembly holds at first taut sample.

handlers.role: Manually secures the lower rope end to the support assembly during the first setup interval.
With target consent, manually routes the upper end and secures it to the target harness during the second setup interval.

platform.position: Fixed small landing pad under the target's initial footprint; it supports the target at t=0 and is the only landing surface in the fall corridor.

ascentShaft.clear: Open vertical path; no obstruction intersects the target body envelope through the full 60-ft unrestrained movement. The top clearance remains at least 4 ft.

targetEnvelope.harnessDRing: Side D-ring lies at x=0, outside the body envelope; body is 0.75 ft from the rope centerline and 0.25 ft from the channel boundary.

ropeChannel.clear: Clear vertical service channel beside the target, with a floor slot at x=0; rope does not cross the body envelope or landing pad.

spatialLayout.fallPath: At event end, target body descends vertically from its current feet z to the fixed pad at z=0. The rope channel remains outside the body path.

firstTaut.rope: Intact; 40 ft slack fully consumed; 10-ft/s scheduled displacement is blocked through t=24.

eventEnd.upwardSupport: Ends exactly at t=24; no ongoing suspension is asserted.
eventEnd.fallStart: Ordinary Falling begins because the target has no remaining upward support. The below-target tether cannot keep the target aloft.

fall.timing: Use the source's outside-initiative virtual slot and rescue window; the after-effect release branch below uses the target's one Action in that window.
fall.impact: min(10, floor(40/20))d6 = 2d6 bludgeoning under the provisional test procedure; then Falling ends and the target is Prone if positive damage is suffered.
fall.landing: Target lands on TEST_PLATFORM_01 at z=0; no other landing surface or rescue effect is stipulated in this branch.

expectedSettlement.rope: Intact and slack at landing; the attachment no longer restrains upward or downward movement. Its own 600-second deadline remains t=600 from cast.
expectedSettlement.support: Fixed and undamaged; assembly held at 210 lb.
expectedSettlement.targetAndGear: Target, harness, harness connector, satchel, and other gear move together; nothing is dropped.
expectedSettlement.costs: Synthetic 2-RP Conjure Rope input remains paid; no refund or duplicate cast. This is not actual paid-cast evidence.

activeEventVoluntaryRelease.action: At t=23, spend one TEST_ONLY Action to manually open the target-side snap link; this is not a Rope Bonus Action command.
activeEventVoluntaryRelease.result: The tether stops restraining immediately. The remaining one-second scheduled upward movement is 10 ft; at t=24 the event ends, then the target falls 50 ft to the platform.

afterEventVoluntaryRelease.action: After t=24, during the source-defined rescue opportunity before the first Falling Step, spend one Action to manually open the now-slack target-side snap link.
afterEventVoluntaryRelease.result: The fall already began when upward support ended; releasing the slack tether does not undo, arrest, or reset the fall. Target still lands after 40 ft with the same ordinary Falling resolution.

releaseAndFailure.supportOverrating: Above 250 lb, the complete TEST_ONLY assembly releases at its support-side weak link. During the active event, remaining scheduled displacement continues; after t=24, ordinary Falling applies.
releaseAndFailure.ropeOverloadZeroHpOrExpiry: At >300 lb, 0 HP, or t=600 expiry, the whole rope vanishes under the bound Conjure Rope procedure. The 300-lb overload is immediate. If this happens during t=18..24, only remaining scheduled displacement runs until t=24; afterward ordinary Falling applies.
releaseAndFailure.laterLoadChange: Every later mass change is immediately resampled; the first-taut result grants no exemption.
releaseAndFailure.simultaneousFailure: If load exceeds both the 250-lb assembly limit and the 300-lb rope limit, both assembly release and rope disappearance occur independently.
releaseAndFailure.boundary: All capacities, attachment permissions, target consent, 1:1 load conversion, movement schedule, geometry and release probes are TEST_ONLY for this branch; no general physical-force model, canon rule, actual support rating, or campaign event is asserted.

failureProbeCases.classification: TEST_ONLY boundary probe; not an actual event
failureProbeCases.expected: The 250-lb assembly weak link releases at the support end; the 300-lb rope remains intact. The scheduled upward movement continues for t=22..24, reaching 60 ft total, then the event ends and a 60-ft ordinary fall resolves to the platform (3d6 bludgeoning under the bound provisional procedure; Prone if positive).

failureProbeCases.classification: TEST_ONLY boundary probe; not an actual event
failureProbeCases.expected: The 250-lb support assembly releases and the >300-lb rope immediately vanishes under its existing overload rule. The scheduled upward movement continues for t=22..24, reaching 60 ft total, then the event ends and a 60-ft ordinary fall resolves (3d6 bludgeoning; Prone if positive).

failureProbeCases.classification: TEST_ONLY load-recheck unit probe; no campaign mechanism asserted
failureProbeCases.when: First taut sample at t=22; at t=23 a stipulated zero-impulse TEST_ONLY attached-mass input increases cargo by 100 lb.
failureProbeCases.expected: The held branch is immediately resampled at t=23. The support assembly releases and the >300-lb rope vanishes. Only the remaining one-second scheduled 10-ft ascent applies; event ends at t=24 at body-feet z=50, then 50-ft ordinary fall resolves to the platform (2d6 bludgeoning; Prone if positive).
